_about: Demo personas for the test console Phone tab (mirror of backend/apps/frontend/src/features/phone/personas.ts). All numbers are fake. Seed matching [DEMO] Chatwoot contacts on the demo tenant so caller lookup finds them.

_how_lookup_reads_the_crm.contact: matched by phone_number (E.164, digits-only, country-code tolerant). name -> first name the assistant confirms; contact custom attribute vehicle_no -> plate (assistant only ever hears the last 4); contact custom attribute vehicle_model (optional).
_how_lookup_reads_the_crm.conversations: every conversation of the contact: custom attributes vehicle_plate + vehicle_model add a car (one conversation per car for a second car); label dealer_<slug> on the most recent one -> usual dealer; status open/pending/snoozed -> open case count.
_how_lookup_reads_the_crm.dealer: petaling_jaya must be a configured dealer (Escalation Routing page / DealerStore, or DEALER_EMAIL_MAP_JSON) for the spoken-dealer match and the handoff dealer_petaling_jaya label.

personas.label: Ahmad (known customer)
personas.description: Proton X50, plate DMO 1101, dealer Petaling Jaya.
personas.scriptHint: Ask to book a service for your X50.

personas.label: Nurul (Bahasa Melayu, open complaint)
personas.description: Proton Saga, plate DMO 1102, dealer Petaling Jaya, one open complaint case.
personas.scriptHint: Speak Malay; ask for an update on your complaint, then ask for a person.

personas.label: Lim (fleet, two cars)
personas.description: Proton X70 DMO 1103 and Proton Persona DMO 1104, dealer Petaling Jaya.
personas.scriptHint: Speak Mandarin; ask about warranty. The assistant should ask which car.

personas.label: Farid (breakdown on the highway)
personas.description: Proton X70, plate DMO 1105, dealer Petaling Jaya.
personas.scriptHint: Say your car stopped on the highway. Safety first, then handoff.

personas.label: New caller (not in CRM)
personas.scriptHint: Give your name, plate DMO 1106 and say you use the Shah Alam service centre (not a configured dealer: stored as text, no label).

personas.label: Unknown caller (no number)
personas.description: No caller ID reaches the assistant.
personas.scriptHint: The assistant must ask for your mobile number; say one of the persona numbers or any other.

personas.label: Custom number
personas.description: Call as any mobile number you type below.
personas.scriptHint: Use a number that exists (or not) in the CRM.
